boundary: Level 4 would be right if the report exposed many recipients' contact data or a sensitive category to an unknown party; as two delivery addresses and phones of one person sent to a single carrier-partner liaison, 3 is right.
factor: contact data of one individual sent to a single external partner contact
note: The assessor described the report as personal data of parcel recipients in the plural (names, home addresses, phone numbers), which the audit marks unsupported and level-moving: the report covers two parcels for one person, Rina Kuroda. Inflating the scope to multiple people pushes toward the higher level, matching the prediction of 4 against gold 3.
